single_candidate.name: Upper-quantile node emphasis
single_candidate.normalized_definition: S_qr,w=sum_wet_i(sum_k w_k*rho_tau_k(log1p(R_i)-qlog_i,k)/sum_k w_k); w_k>0 fixed and tau-only
single_candidate.normalization_reason: All-one weights reproduce original mean over32nodes. Global lambda, per-valid denominator and other objectives require an explicitly fixed protocol.
single_candidate.training_total_reminder: J=(S_occ+lambda_q*S_qr,w)/N_valid; do not replace training denominator with N_rain.
single_candidate.semantic_condition: Independent population quantile optimization with positive weights preserves each ideal target. Shared constrained finite-network optimization does not guarantee simultaneous quantile accuracy.
single_candidate.stopping_rule: B结束，不扩读数组或缓存。后续只有预设干预与护栏及研究者准确批准后才进入新训练，不自动扫权重。
